items.question: Do I need to install any app?
items.answer: No. BossZap works directly from WhatsApp. You just need to send a message to get started.

items.question: Can I cancel anytime?
items.answer: Yes. There are no contracts or commitments. You can cancel your subscription anytime from your dashboard.

items.question: Is my data secure?
items.answer: Absolutely. We use end-to-end encryption and comply with data protection regulations.

items.question: What happens after the 7 free days?
items.answer: Your Professional plan will activate. If you decide not to continue, simply cancel before the trial ends and you won't be charged.
